contentPattern.structure: teaser grid from a DA sheet + category filter tabs built from a `category` column

config.source: path to a DA sheet ending in .json, e.g. /us/en/adventures/query-index.json (columns: path, title, description, image, category)

suitableFor: listing pages needing a card grid plus author-defined category filter tabs (Adventures Current Adventures)
notSuitableFor: auto-syncing section lists (use cards-index with a prefix)

notes: Reads the sheet, renders cards via cards-teaser, and builds All + per-category tabs from distinct `category` values (client-side show/hide, reusing global .adventure-tabs styles). DA project, no _model file.
